input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: There is no limitation-of-liability, aggregate-liability or exclusion-of-damages language anywhere in the Agreement: Section 9 (Warranties) contains only mutual authority representations and the Globix acknowledgement, Section 10 (General Provisions) runs from Notices to Headings with no cap, and the only occurrences of \"liability\" are in the No Joint Venture clause (10.2). Both Parties are therefore exposed to unlimited liability, and the Company (as the paying party with indemnity-free exposure) is unprotected. We inserted the shortest conforming clause at the fallback level: a mutual aggregate cap of the fees paid or payable by the Company in the twelve months preceding the claim, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct carved out as Excluded Claims. We did not pursue the preferred greater-of USD 1,000,000 formulation, mutual consequential-damages exclusion or the additional carve-outs, as the fallback is the minimum acceptable position here.

proposal.summary: Insert a mutual 12-months'-fees liability cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no limitation of liability, leaving both Parties exposed to unlimited damages; we added a mutual cap of twelve months' fees at our fallback position, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's indemnification obligations, its breach of its confidentiality obligations, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
